name: Azure Repos
summary: Azure Repos is the source control service in Azure DevOps. It supports Git, with pull requests and branch policies, and Team Foundation Version Control. The first 5 Basic users are free, and each extra Basic user costs $6 a month.

facts.text: Azure Repos supports two kinds of version control: Git, which is distributed, and Team Foundation Version Control, which is centralized.
Branch policies can require a minimum number of reviewers, comment resolution, linked work items, build validation and status checks on pull requests.
Branch permissions can be set for individual users and groups. They include Contribute, Force push, Edit policies, Manage permissions, and Bypass policies when completing pull requests.
Stakeholder access is free. Stakeholders can use work items, boards, Pipelines and Artifacts, but they do not get Azure Repos.

plans.name: Basic (additional users)
plans.notes: Shown as /mo. Charged daily on assigned users and pro-rated

plans.name: Stakeholder
plans.notes: Free. Does not include Azure Repos

hiddenCosts: Azure Artifacts storage beyond 2 GiB free per organization starts at $2 per GiB.
Microsoft-hosted pipelines include 1 free parallel job with 1,800 minutes a month. Pipelines are billed separately from Repos.
Prices are calculated in US dollars and converted to other currencies at London closing spot rates, so local prices vary.
